title: Hardwiring a circuit family
statement: Let $a$ assign a natural number to each input length. For each $n$, let $D_n$ be a directed acyclic Boolean circuit with $n+a(n)$ inputs, and let $\alpha_n$ be a Boolean assignment to its last $a(n)$ inputs. The resulting circuit family assigns to each $n$ the circuit obtained by hardwiring $\alpha_n$ into $D_n$.
hypotheses_covered: A function $a$ from natural numbers to natural numbers
For every $n$, a circuit with $n+a(n)$ inputs
For every $n$, a Boolean assignment to $a(n)$ inputs
